name: Skiphosoura
isnote: Recovered as a non-pterodactyloid member of Pterodactyliformes (Hone et al. 2024).
sum: ‘Sword tail’: a transitional monofenestratan from the Late Jurassic Mörnsheim Formation of Bavaria, with a short, stiff tail.
wsnote: 1.75 m; may not have been fully grown.
holotype: LF 4157 (Lauer Foundation) — Mörnsheim Formation, Schaudiberg Quarry, Bavaria.
material: Nearly complete, disarticulated skeleton with partial skull, many bones in 3D.
biology: Body plan intermediate between long-tailed pterosaurs and pterodactyloids.
author: Hone et al. 2024
dates_note: Age bracket from the stage named in the literature (ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart); not in PBDB at time of download.
